interfaces.signature: navigateToPostList(categoryId?: string) -> void
postconditions: Post list page rendered with paginated posts, filtered by category if specified

failure_modes.trigger: API returns error or network timeout
failure_modes.behavior: Show error toast with retry button. Page remains in loading skeleton state.
failure_modes.propagation: Caught by mp-api-client, surfaced as error state in page data binding.

test_contracts.scenario: Network error on post list load

extension_points: New page types added via app.json pages array + subpackage config
sealed_points: Page lifecycle methods follow WeChat onLoad/onShow/onHide/onUnload contract
state_owned: Current page data (posts list, scroll position)

interfaces.signature: post-card: properties={post: Post, showCategory: boolean} -> WXML template
preconditions: Post object has required fields: id, title, content, author, created_at
postconditions: Card renders with title, excerpt, author avatar, category tag, timestamp

failure_modes.trigger: Post object has missing optional fields (e.g., no avatarUrl)
failure_modes.behavior: Render default avatar placeholder. No crash.
failure_modes.propagation: Handled internally via WXML wx:if conditional rendering.

test_contracts.scenario: Post with all fields renders completely
Post with missing avatar renders default

extension_points: New components added in components/ directory, registered in page JSON
sealed_points: Component property types match Post/Comment/User/Category domain types

interfaces.signature: request<T>(method, path, body?, params?) -> Promise<ApiResponse<T>>
preconditions: JWT token is available from mp-auth module
path is a valid backend endpoint
postconditions: Parsed typed response or structured ApiError

failure_modes.behavior: Clear stored token, emit 'auth-expired' event, redirect to login page
failure_modes.propagation: Caught in response interceptor. Auth-expired event handled by app.ts onAuthExpired handler.

test_contracts.verifies: Timeout error surfaced with retry info

failure_modes.behavior: Return error with retryAfter seconds. Page shows cooldown indicator.
failure_modes.propagation: Caught in response interceptor, surfaced as rate_limit_error type.

extension_points: New HTTP method wrappers (upload, download) for file attachments
sealed_points: Base URL is fixed to configured backend endpoint. Token injection is mandatory.

interfaces.signature: connect(token: string) -> Promise<void>
preconditions: JWT token is valid and fresh
postconditions: WebSocket connected and authenticated. State = 'connected'.

failure_modes.trigger: Connection fails after max retries (5 attempts)
failure_modes.behavior: State → 'failed'. Emit 'ws-disconnected' event. UI shows 'connection lost' banner.
failure_modes.propagation: Event handled by page layer. User can manually retry via 'reconnect' button.

test_contracts.scenario: Max retries exhausted enters failed state

failure_modes.behavior: Close connection. Emit 'auth-expired'. Clear token. Redirect to login.
failure_modes.propagation: Auth-expired event → app.ts handler → login page redirect.

test_contracts.scenario: Auth failure on WS connect triggers login

interfaces.signature: sendMessage(msg: OutgoingMessage) -> Promise<string>
preconditions: msg has type, to, content fields
postconditions: Message sent with unique msgId. Returns msgId for tracking.

failure_modes.behavior: Queue message locally. Retry on reconnect. Fail after queue TTL (5 min).
failure_modes.propagation: Message status updated in local store. User sees 'sending...' → 'sent' or 'failed'.

test_contracts.scenario: Send while disconnected queues and retries
test_contracts.verifies: Message queued locally, sent on reconnect

extension_points: Additional message types via JSON 'type' discriminator field
sealed_points: WSS protocol mandatory for production. Heartbeat interval = 30s.

interfaces.signature: login() -> Promise<UserInfo>
postconditions: JWT stored in local storage. User info returned with nickname and avatar.

failure_modes.trigger: wx.login fails (WeChat service error, user cancelled)
failure_modes.behavior: Return error with code. UI shows 'login failed' with retry.
failure_modes.propagation: Error surfaced to calling page. Login button remains available for retry.

test_contracts.verifies: Error state renders with retry button

interfaces.signature: getToken() -> string | null
postconditions: Returns stored JWT or null if not logged in

interfaces.signature: logout() -> void
postconditions: JWT cleared from storage. WebSocket disconnected. All local state reset.

sealed_points: Only WeChat login supported — no email/password, no SSO
state_shared: User auth state (read by mp-api-client, mp-ws-client, mp-pages)

interfaces.signature: POST /api/auth/login {code: string} -> {token: string, user: UserResponse}
preconditions: WeChat login code is valid and not expired (5 min TTL)
postconditions: JWT issued. User created if first login. Token returned.

failure_modes.trigger: WeChat code2session returns error (invalid code, rate limit)
failure_modes.behavior: Return 400 with error_code: INVALID_CODE or 429 with RATE_LIMITED
failure_modes.propagation: Handled by FastAPI exception handler → structured JSON error response.

interfaces.signature: GET /api/posts?category=id&cursor=token&limit=20 -> {items: Post[], next_cursor: string|null}
postconditions: Cursor-paginated post list returned. Posts include author summary and comment count.

failure_modes.behavior: Return 503 with RETRYABLE error code
failure_modes.propagation: Exception handler catches DB timeout → 503 response.

test_contracts.scenario: DB timeout returns 503 with retry hint

interfaces.signature: GET /api/messages/conversations -> {conversations: Conversation[]}
postconditions: List of conversations with last message preview and unread count

extension_points: New route modules registered via FastAPI app.include_router()
sealed_points: All routes require JWT auth except POST /api/auth/login. Response format is always {data, error}.

interfaces.signature: ws://api/ws?token=jwt -> WebSocket connection
preconditions: JWT token query parameter is valid
postconditions: WebSocket connection established. User registered in session manager. Online status broadcast.

failure_modes.behavior: Send error frame with code=AUTH_FAILED, close connection with code 4001
failure_modes.propagation: Connection refused. Client receives close event with code 4001.

test_contracts.scenario: Invalid token WS connect is rejected

interfaces.signature: WS message frame: {type: 'message', to: userId, content: string, msgId: string} -> void
postconditions: Message delivered if recipient online, queued if offline. Sender receives ACK.

failure_modes.behavior: Message persisted by message service. Sender gets ACK with status='sent'.
failure_modes.propagation: Message service handles offline queue. Delivered on recipient reconnect.

test_contracts.scenario: Message to offline user is persisted

extension_points: Additional WS message types: typing indicators, read receipts, presence updates
sealed_points: Single endpoint /ws. Multiplexed by message type field. WSS required for production.

interfaces.signature: async login_with_wechat(code: str) -> tuple[User, str]
preconditions: code is a non-empty string from wx.login()
postconditions: User record exists (created if first login). Valid JWT returned with expiry.

failure_modes.behavior: Raise InvalidWeChatCode(code=errcode, msg=errmsg) exception
failure_modes.propagation: Caught by route handler → 400 response with WECHAT_ERROR code

test_contracts.verifies: Retryable error raised with timeout flag

failure_modes.behavior: Raise WeChatAPIError with UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE code
failure_modes.propagation: Caught by route handler → 502 with UPSTREAM_ERROR

test_contracts.verifies: Specific error code for upstream malformation

interfaces.signature: async validate_token(token: str) -> TokenPayload
postconditions: Decoded token payload with user_id, openid, exp. Raises if invalid.

failure_modes.behavior: Raise TokenExpired(expired_at=exp) exception
failure_modes.propagation: FastAPI dependency catches → 401 with TOKEN_EXPIRED code

failure_modes.trigger: Token signature is invalid (tampered or wrong secret)
failure_modes.behavior: Raise InvalidToken exception
failure_modes.propagation: FastAPI dependency catches → 401 with INVALID_TOKEN code

sealed_points: Auth method: WeChat code2session ONLY. No password auth, no OAuth2 flows.

interfaces.signature: async create_post(user_id: int, title: str, content: str, category_id: int) -> Post
postconditions: Post persisted with status='published'. Category post_count incremented atomically.

failure_modes.trigger: Content contains sensitive words from filter list
failure_modes.behavior: Post created with status='flagged'. Return post with warning. Not shown publicly until admin review.
failure_modes.propagation: Flagged status propagated to post listing queries which exclude flagged posts for non-owner, non-admin users.

test_contracts.scenario: Post with sensitive word is flagged

failure_modes.trigger: User exceeds rate limit (e.g., 10 posts per hour)
failure_modes.behavior: Raise RateLimitExceeded(retry_after=seconds) exception
failure_modes.propagation: Route handler catches → 429 response with Retry-After header

test_contracts.scenario: 11th post in one hour is rate limited

extension_points: Post statuses: published, flagged, hidden, deleted. Extend with 'pinned', 'locked'.
sealed_points: Soft-delete only. Posts are never hard-deleted. Title 200 char limit. Content 10000 char limit.

interfaces.signature: async create_comment(user_id: int, post_id: int, content: str, parent_id: int|null) -> Comment
preconditions: user_id and post_id reference existing records
if parent_id set, references existing comment on same post and depth < 2
postconditions: Comment persisted. Post comment_count incremented.

failure_modes.trigger: parent_id references a comment at max depth (level 2)
failure_modes.behavior: Raise MaxCommentDepth(max_depth=2) exception
failure_modes.propagation: Route handler → 400 with MAX_DEPTH error code

test_contracts.scenario: Reply to level-2 comment is rejected

failure_modes.trigger: parent_id references comment on different post
failure_modes.behavior: Raise CommentMismatch exception
failure_modes.propagation: Route handler → 400 with PARENT_MISMATCH error code

test_contracts.scenario: Reply with wrong post_id parent combo

sealed_points: Max comment depth = 2 (post → comment → reply). Content 2000 char limit. Soft-delete only.

interfaces.signature: async send_message(from_id: int, to_id: int, content: str, msg_id: str) -> MessageDeliveryResult
preconditions: from_id and to_id reference existing users
postconditions: Message persisted. If recipient online, delivered via WebSocket. If offline, queued for delivery.

failure_modes.behavior: Return existing message's delivery status. No duplicate persisted.
failure_modes.propagation: Transparent to sender — they get the original message's status.

test_contracts.verifies: No duplicate row, same status returned

failure_modes.behavior: Raise UserNotFound(to_id=to_id) exception
failure_modes.propagation: Route handler → 404 with USER_NOT_FOUND

extension_points: Message types: text, image, system_notification. Extend via type discriminator.
sealed_points: Content 5000 char limit. No file/attachment support in MVP.

interfaces.signature: async list_categories() -> list[Category]
postconditions: All active categories returned ordered by sort_order. Includes post_count.

interfaces.signature: async create_category(name: str, description: str) -> Category
postconditions: New category persisted and returned

failure_modes.behavior: Raise DuplicateCategory(name=name) exception
failure_modes.propagation: Route handler → 409 with DUPLICATE_NAME

sealed_points: Categories are flat (no nesting). Sort order is numeric ascending.

interfaces.signature: async register(user_id: int, ws: WebSocket) -> void
preconditions: ws is an active WebSocket connection
postconditions: User registered as online. Previous connection for same user replaced. 'user_online' event broadcast.

interfaces.signature: async unregister(user_id: int) -> void
postconditions: User removed from online set. 'user_offline' event broadcast if no other connections.

interfaces.signature: is_online(user_id: int) -> bool
postconditions: True if user has active WebSocket connection

interfaces.signature: async send_to_user(user_id: int, data: dict) -> bool
postconditions: Message sent if online (returns true). Returns false if offline.

failure_modes.behavior: Unregister user. Return false. Message service handles offline delivery fallback.
failure_modes.propagation: Unregister triggers cleanup. Message service sees offline status → persists for later delivery.

sealed_points: ponytail: single dict with asyncio.Lock for {user_id: WebSocket}. Per-account locks if lock contention measured.
state_owned: Active connections map: dict[int, WebSocket]. Protected by asyncio.Lock.

interfaces.signature: async get_db() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]
preconditions: Database URL is configured and reachable
postconditions: Yields async SQLAlchemy session. Commits on success, rolls back on exception. Returned to pool.

failure_modes.trigger: Connection pool exhausted (all connections in use)
failure_modes.behavior: Raise ConnectionPoolExhausted after timeout (30s default)
failure_modes.propagation: Exception handler → 503 response. Health check endpoint reflects degraded status.

extension_points: Additional middleware: rate limiting, request ID tracking, metrics collection
sealed_points: Database: PostgreSQL via asyncpg. Session factory uses async SQLAlchemy 2.0.

interfaces.signature: PostCreate {title: str(1-200), content: str(1-10000), category_id: int} -> validates and returns PostCreate model
postconditions: Validated Pydantic model instance or ValidationError with field-level details

failure_modes.trigger: title is empty string or exceeds 200 chars
failure_modes.behavior: Pydantic ValidationError with loc=['title'] and type='string_too_long'
failure_modes.propagation: FastAPI automatically returns 422 with detail from ValidationError

extension_points: New schemas added per domain module as needed
sealed_points: All schemas use Pydantic v2 with strict mode. Response schemas exclude internal fields.

interfaces.signature: User(id: int PK, openid: str unique, nickname: str, avatar_url: str, role: str, created_at: datetime)
preconditions: Table exists with indexes on openid, created_at
postconditions: ORM model available for query and mutation via SQLAlchemy

interfaces.signature: Post(id: int PK, title: str, content: str, user_id: int FK, category_id: int FK, status: str, view_count: int, comment_count: int, created_at: datetime, updated_at: datetime)
preconditions: Table exists with indexes on user_id, category_id, status, created_at. TSVECTOR GIN index on search_vector.
postconditions: ORM model. Relationships: author (User), category (Category), comments (Comment[]).

interfaces.signature: Message(id: int PK, msg_id: str unique, from_id: int FK, to_id: int FK, content: str, status: str, created_at: datetime)
preconditions: Table exists with indexes on msg_id (unique), conversation lookup (from_id, to_id, created_at)
postconditions: ORM model. Status transitions: sent → delivered → read. Unique constraint on msg_id for idempotency.

extension_points: New columns added via Alembic migrations
sealed_points: All models use SQLAlchemy 2.0 Mapped[] style. UTC timestamps. Soft-delete via status column.
state_shared: Database tables are shared state. Coordination via PostgreSQL transactions and constraints.

interfaces.signature: async find_by_openid(db: AsyncSession, openid: str) -> User | None
preconditions: db is an active async session
postconditions: User object or None

interfaces.signature: async create_from_wechat(db: AsyncSession, openid: str, nickname: str, avatar_url: str) -> User
preconditions: openid is not already in database
postconditions: New User persisted with role='user'

failure_modes.trigger: openid already exists (race condition between check and insert)
failure_modes.behavior: IntegrityError caught, retry find_by_openid and return existing user
failure_modes.propagation: Caught by repository. Caller receives user (existing or new) transparently.

test_contracts.verifies: One user created, both callers get user

sealed_points: ponytail: simple find_by_openid + create. Add user search/pagination when needed.

interfaces.signature: async list_posts(db: AsyncSession, category_id: int|None, cursor: str|None, limit: int) -> tuple[list[Post], str|None]
postconditions: Cursor-paginated posts with eager-loaded author and category. Returns (items, next_cursor).

interfaces.signature: async search_posts(db: AsyncSession, query: str, cursor: str|None, limit: int) -> tuple[list[Post], str|None]
postconditions: Full-text search results via PostgreSQL TSVECTOR. Ranked by relevance.

extension_points: Additional filter dimensions: by_user, by_status, date_range
sealed_points: ponytail: cursor = base64(created_at + id). No offset pagination to avoid consistency issues under concurrent inserts.

interfaces.signature: async find_by_post(db: AsyncSession, post_id: int) -> list[Comment]
postconditions: Comments for post with eager-loaded author. Tree built in-memory from flat result.

sealed_points: ponytail: flat query + in-memory tree. Add recursive CTE if threading depth > 2 ever needed.

interfaces.signature: async find_conversation(db: AsyncSession, user_a: int, user_b: int, limit: int, before_id: int|None) -> list[Message]
preconditions: user_a and user_b are valid user ids
postconditions: Messages between two users, ordered by created_at DESC, paginated by before_id

interfaces.signature: async get_unread_count(db: AsyncSession, user_id: int, from_id: int) -> int
postconditions: Count of messages with status != 'read' sent from from_id to user_id

interfaces.signature: async mark_delivered(db: AsyncSession, msg_ids: list[str]) -> void
postconditions: Messages updated to status='delivered'

sealed_points: ponytail: simple between-two-users query. Group chat schema differs — add when needed.

interfaces.signature: async list_all(db: AsyncSession) -> list[Category]
postconditions: All non-deleted categories ordered by sort_order

sealed_points: ponytail: list_all is sufficient for <50 categories. Add pagination if category count grows.

interfaces.signature: GET https://api.weixin.qq.com/sns/jscode2session?appid=APPID&secret=SECRET&js_code=CODE&grant_type=authorization_code -> {openid, session_key, unionid?, errcode?, errmsg?}
preconditions: code is a fresh wx.login() code (5 min TTL)
postconditions: openid returned if code valid. errcode != 0 on failure.

failure_modes.behavior: External service error. Caller should retry with backoff.
failure_modes.propagation: be-auth-service catches → raises WeChatAPIError with RETRYABLE flag

sealed_points: External service — not owned by this project. Interface documented for boundary clarity only.
